rationale: The response recognizes the suburban flying-trampoline scenario and gives practical, safety-minded advice (check for downed lines, document, involve neighbor). quote: Make sure no power lines are involved. If the trampoline is touching or near a downed line, stay far away and call 911 / utility company.
